No prose about service dependencies, editions, or roles - unlike server/'s query-service.json (prior round), which stated the Query-Service-depends-on-Index-Service/Data-Service relationships in prose, this metrics catalog states nothing structural. See metrics-reference.json (this batch) for the consolidated dependsOnService finding.
